Hollywood keeps spending hundreds of millions of dollars remaking movies we’ve already seen.

And somehow… that can be less risky than spending $50 million on something completely original.

So Caya went through decades of box office data to figure out why original movies are disappearing—and whether Hollywood has actually run out of ideas.

The answer has a lot less to do with creativity than you might think.
